scenarios.name: two valid hex values and read byte bit7 clear
scenarios.oracle: return count; update bytes +0x3f2/+0x3f3; one read of reg 0x1d length 1; one write reg 0x1d length 2; output [low8(first),low8(second)] under mutex

scenarios.name: two valid values and read byte bit7 set
scenarios.oracle: write first byte with bit7 preserved from read; replace all low seven bits with low8(first)

scenarios.name: zero or one conversion
scenarios.oracle: return count; no state write, lock, or bus calls

scenarios.name: read helper error
scenarios.oracle: still issue write and unlock; no error propagated; initialize temporary read buffer to zero to match stock pre-call stores

scenarios.name: write helper error
scenarios.oracle: unlock and return count; no error propagated

scenarios.name: overflowing hex input
scenarios.oracle: sscanf %x conversion semantics, then truncate each converted word to low byte; do not substitute kstrtou8 or add range checks
